name: Ipamorelin
description: Synthetic five-amino-acid growth hormone secretagogue, including amino acids not found in nature

note.text: In the bowel-surgery trial, time to the first tolerated meal did not differ significantly from placebo.

bullets: **Acts on the ghrelin receptor** in the pituitary to release GH
**In pigs,** did not raise ACTH or cortisol, unlike GHRP-6 and GHRP-2
**In healthy men,** one GH burst, peaking at about 40 minutes (by vein)
**For sleep,** no effect or mechanism has been studied
Phase II RCT, 117 adults: no significant benefit
Second Phase II (320): no results posted

practical.pharmacokinetics: Drug levels rose in proportion to the dose
practical.soldAs: Not approved; FDA Category 2 for 503B compounding
practical.monitored: GH and drug levels; time to first meal, adverse events

regulatory.text: Not in the Oct 2026 peptide policy

references: FDA, Category 2 bulk drug substances (significant safety risks), Apr 2026
Beck et al., Int J Colorectal Dis, ipamorelin after bowel surgery, Dec 2014
Gobburu et al., Pharm Res, ipamorelin in healthy men, Sep 1999
